test_policy.notes: Test-optional for applicants seeking to enroll in fall 2027 (2026-27 cycle). Princeton returns to requiring SAT or ACT from the 2027-28 cycle (fall 2028 entry). Score choice allowed within one format; no superscoring across paper and digital.

requirements.notes: Princeton-specific Questions plus a graded written paper (preferably English or history) are required. Alumni interviews are optional and can be opted out of in the Princeton-specific Questions. Financial aid uses the free Princeton Financial Aid Application (PFAA). Application fee amount not stated on the pages checked.

deadlines.label: Single-Choice Early Action
deadlines.notes: Non-binding; may not apply to other private early programs in the US. Decision mid-December (no exact date published). Reply by May 1.

deadlines.label: Regular Decision
deadlines.notes: Decision late March (no exact date published). Reply by May 1.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Not required if English is your native language or you have spent at least three years at a secondary school where English is the primary language of instruction.

english.notes: Any one of TOEFL, IELTS Academic, Duolingo or PTE Academic is required. No minimum score published on the pages checked.
IELTS Academic. No minimum score published.
PTE Academic. No minimum score published.

aid.notes: Need-blind for all applicants including international; full demonstrated need met with grants (no loans). No merit scholarships. Same aid policy regardless of citizenship.

tier_notes.computer_science: Top-10 CS department; just outside the top-5 group.
tier_notes.engineering: Top-15 engineering school, small but research-intensive.
tier_notes.business: No undergraduate business major (Economics is the usual route).
tier_notes.biology_life_sci: Molecular Biology and EEB are top-10 life-science departments.
tier_notes.pre_med: No medical school, but strong research access and medical-school outcomes (same basis as MIT).
tier_notes.economics: Economics department is consistently top-5 nationally.
tier_notes.math_physics: Mathematics is ranked #1 nationally and physics is top-5.
tier_notes.humanities: Humanities departments (history, philosophy, English, classics) are among the very best in the US.
tier_notes.arts_design: Lewis Center for the Arts and an undergraduate architecture major; no conservatory-style arts school.
